title: Relativity and Quantum Revolutions
centralClaim: Classical physics' assumptions about space, time, measurement, matter, probability, and observation were fundamentally challenged and rebuilt.
whyItMatters: These revolutions reshaped our understanding of the universe at its most fundamental levels, leading to transformative technologies and ongoing scientific inquiry.

contributors.name: Albert Einstein
contributors.reason: Developed special and general relativity, fundamentally altering concepts of space and time. His work laid groundwork for subsequent quantum developments.

texts.title: Relativity: The Special and General Theory

contributors.name: Max Planck
contributors.reason: Introduced the concept of quantized energy, marking the birth of quantum theory and challenging classical thermodynamics.

texts.title: On the Motion of Heat Radiation

contributors.name: Richard Feynman
contributors.reason: Developed path integral formulation of quantum mechanics and made significant contributions to quantum electrodynamics, clarifying complex phenomena.

texts.title: QED: The Strange Theory of Light and Matter

objections: Initial resistance to relativity due to conflict with Newtonian mechanics.
Early quantum theory faced criticism for its probabilistic nature and apparent abandonment of determinism.
The incompatibility between general relativity and quantum mechanics remains a major challenge.
Interpretational problems within quantum mechanics (e.g., the measurement problem).
